name: Kwii.aang spruce-root hat
description: The Smithsonian attributes a Haida spruce-root hat of approximately 1900 to weaving by Kwii.aang and painting by Da.axiigang.

date.label: About 1900
date.basis: The date is scoped to this described observation, text, archaeological interpretation or object, not the origin of the wider practice.

events.statement: The Smithsonian attributes a Haida spruce-root hat of approximately 1900 to weaving by Kwii.aang and painting by Da.axiigang.

evidence.supports: The Smithsonian dates the Haida hat to approximately 1900, attributes its weaving to Kwii.aang (Isabella Edenshaw) and painting to Da.axiigang (Charles Edenshaw), and presents family testimony on weaving. This one object does not date the origin of the wider craft.

events.caveats: Object date and attribution do not date the origin of Haida weaving; the family account describes work across a broader period, not a dated account of this particular hat.
